title: Commons Imaging reads the rectangular corner of a JPEG-compressed TIFF
summary: The corrected decoder matched all 16,129 reference pixels within tolerance. The six bottom-right pixels were bit-identical through the whole-image and regional APIs. The original 264×264 control passed on both revisions.

change.description: The TIFF reader’s internal JPEG decoder now clips its RGB pixel output to the remaining image width and height.

notes: The original 264×264 image control runs on both revisions. The small image and its rectangular edge comparison run on the fixed decoder. The earlier setup independently recorded a parent bounds exception in the transplanted upstream tests.
Each deployment checks the JDK fingerprint, ordered artifact digests, caller classes and original class providers. The same compiled caller runs both sides in fresh JVMs.
